title: Test 12 — Scan a hystologic sample and show all the surface in one image
agent_prompt: Scan the entire sample, taking an image with a 40x objective. Once the scanning is complete, create a mosaic of the images. The overlap between the different fields of view of the images must not exceed 30%. Save all the images from the different fields of view in one folder, and save the mosaic image in another folder. Add all the images to the napari GUI. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: Images of the different field of view
All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
